title: A large-scale study on developer engagement and expertise in configurable software system projects
core_idea: Examine developer engagement with variable versus mandatory code in configurable software systems (where variability is implemented via preprocessor directives), analyze the concentration of variable-code workload across developers, and evaluate whether conventional expertise metrics effectively capture proficiency with variable code by mining repositories of 25 CSS projects and tens of thousands of commits and developers.
tldr: Empirical study that analyzes who works on variability (preprocessor-based variable code) in configurable systems and assesses whether standard expertise metrics identify those developers, using large-scale repository mining.
